body.statement: Uniformly over \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{global,reg}}\), prefixes with \(k\le\ell_n\) are root-\(n\) equivalent to the no-borrowing prefix and prefixes with \(n_{\mathcal E}-k\le\ell_n\) are root-\(n\) equivalent to the full-borrowing prefix: \[\max_{k\le\ell_n}d_n(k,0)+\max_{n_{\mathcal E}-k\le\ell_n}d_n(k,n_{\mathcal E})\longrightarrow0.\]
body.justification: The edge reduction permits analysis of every top-\(k\) prefix without imposing an impossible uniform quantile-density condition at ranks zero and one.
body.gap: Chernozhukov, Fernandez-Val, and Luo treat compact interior quantile indices; Yang, Li, Wu, and Yang search the entire prefix path, including its extremes.
body.consumer: The all-prefix Gaussian coupling can combine an interior sorted-process argument with stable no-borrowing and full-borrowing endpoints.
